role: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or engineer (Ballarat VIC)
subject: Speculative enquiry: graduate civil designer or engineer, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

This is a speculative enquiry, not a reply to an advertised vacancy. Your careers page invites people who want to work with Axiom to upload a CV, so I wanted to introduce myself.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am based in Melton, hold a White Card, a licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your Maddingly Village work near Bacchus Marsh, from earthworks, drainage and pavement design through to Superintendent on site, is the mix of design and construction I want to learn. My drafting so far is from study rather than a paid Australian role.

Would you keep me in mind for a graduate civil design or engineering opening, now or later? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

SPECULATIVE_ENQUIRY. SEEK sweeps at 3, 7 and 14 days (60 then 80 details) plus the councils and government rotation found no new junior adverts that cleared screening (all duplicates of tracked employers or 3+ years, degree-plus-experience, student-only or citizenship/PR roles), so this is the runbook's one speculative enquiry. Axiom careers page read 12 Oct 2026 AEDT shows no vacancy and an upload form. Ballarat is about an hour from Melton, so no relocation is implied.
Axiom's own site publishes only admin@axiomce.com.au (general contact, not stated to take applications) and a careers upload form, so the route is the careers form. A named engineer address appears only on a third-party surveyor's page, so it was not used (contact rule: employer-published only). Gmail in:anywhere search for Axiom found no prior contact; tracker check found no Axiom record.
